note: One existing DAVIS cell of the cheapest attention model (ColdSite-DTI), retrained under the harness with its committed seed. Level cold_target: one committed-seed SD of 0.0109 AUROC is a tolerance a broken harness would not meet by luck, unlike cold_pair (SD 0.0991), and the cell ran 26 epochs at seed 1, about an hour on one T4 at the ~2 min 15 s/epoch measured on Kaggle (CLAUDE.md section 4). The level was chosen AFTER looking at the committed SDs, for that reason; the canary is a harness check and adds nothing to any family.
